title: Add an application SDK facade: decide, review, status, subscribe
description:
A small Python facade over DecisionFlywheel for applications that embed one cyclotron. Cyclotron.open(store, definition, model, optimizer=None). decide(item) -> Decision {decision_id, item_id, label, confidence, probabilities, version, review {selected, reason, propensity}}. review(decision_id, label, *, explanation=None, reason_code=None, reviewer=None, selected_by='program'|'reviewer') records a label, correction, or undo. status() -> cyclotron-status/v1. subscribe(after=cursor) yields committed events (decision, review, promoted, dropped, review-rate-changed). The facade owns labels, held-out partitions, and selection propensities, which DecisionFlywheel.predict and improve currently require from the caller. Ordering: after the status shape task.

Acceptance criteria:
- An application decides and reviews items keyed by its own ids without building training or development sets.
- Partition assignment happens before the label is seen and survives restarts; held-out labels never reach the LLM optimizer or ML model fit.
- review() with selected_by='reviewer' trains the ML model but is excluded from alignment and audit numbers.
- decide() on an unchanged item and version reuses the cached decision and makes no model call.
- Specs beside the module use fake models; a README quickstart shows the four calls.
